notes.title: Update 33
notes.notes:
[h1][b]What's up everyone! First, thanks for playing SlapBR!!!!!! WE HIT 7,000 DOWNLOADS!![/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Anyways, Updates:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] CROUCHING IN SLAPBR
[*] Holding left ctrl will allow you to crouch and hide in grass and fit through small spaces
[*] you can still slap and block while crouched
[*] 
[*] More spooky sounds have been added for your horror gaming experience
[*] 
[*] Glitches involving leaving the map and pinning yourself against trees have been resolved
[*] yet I know many of you will still find ways to glitch out. 
[*] 
[*] Hitboxes slightly tweaked again for more accurate slapping
[/list]

[h3][b]TELL THE WORLD TO PLAY SLAPBR :)[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Updates Coming through soon.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Few small changes to the game:

1) Base player speed & sprint speed increased

2) Silent Sneak now gives you a speed increase on top of silencing your footsteps

3)  Waiting room submit chat button removed, now just press 'enter,' type, and hit 'enter' again to send messages. 

4) Death Locations: Now when you die: A solid sphere with a particles trail falls from the sky on your death location allowing all other players to briefly see where a kill appeared on the map. 

:) More changes to come soon - John

notes.title: Graphics Settings Now Available
notes.notes:
Graphics settings have been added to the game so you can play slap your friends on any computer in 60FPS!!!!

You can access graphic settings from the title page or from the menu in game by pressing 'esc' and clicking options.

notes.title: SCARY UPDATE + PRACTICE SLAP ROOMS
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Another quick update:

1) Practice rooms our now live! You can use the practice room button to join a practice room and work on slapping up some dummies.

2) Now everyone has a creepy clown skin which gives more terror to the game. 

3) Added more structures and grass around the map. 

3) Bug fixes due to power up spawning and players spawning on each other. 

Slap and share with your friends!

notes.title: SlapBR PowerUps 7/15/2022
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has been enjoying and sharing the game :)

Updates:

1) Added creepy log cabin in the middle of the map

2) Power Ups:
     i) Super Flashlight (grants ability to see the entire map for 4 seconds. 
    ii) Super Jump (gives slight flashlight improvement and 1 giant jump in the air)
   iii) Silent Sneak (Disables your 3D footsteps that were available via 3D audio to other players for 30 seconds)

3) Minor bug fixes
